scope: Fourteen real-scalar statements: the time-reversal chain rule, sign reversal of a given viscous rate and complete scalar RHS, exponential damping/amplification for an assumed Laplacian eigenmode, and Euler-increment sign identities.
open_items: No proof of the coupled Hug solver, threshold switching, path convergence, or residual balance.
No spatial PDE construction or spectral decomposition; q is a supplied Laplacian eigenvalue magnitude.
No stable backward reconstruction theorem; exact exponential cancellation does not imply numerical stability.
No claim that a negative step of a finite-step integrator is its exact inverse.
